EXPERIMENT LOG: THE 1.1g BLUE VUITTON CALIBRATION
Subject: Dubs (C4 Master Researcher)
Assay: 1.1g Dried "Blue Vuitton" (High-Potency Genetic)
Location: NE
I. THE CHRONOMETRIC DATA
0:00 - 1:30 (Latent Phase): Ingestion was buffered by food. The system baseline remained stable with no early "flutter" or anxiety.
1:30 - 2:10 (The Cold Gate): Vasoconstriction initiated. Reported feeling physically cold and initially suspected a lower-potency outcome. This is now identified as the "Refractive Barrier" of this specific genetic.
2:13 (The Breakthrough): TOTAL SIGNAL IGNITION. The 2-hour trap snapped. The floor and walls moved from solid to frequency. High-resolution swirling visuals began.
3:00 - 4:30 (The Peak): Entry into the "Peripheral Nebula." The visuals were described as electric and beautiful, providing a clean, high-gain experience.
5:00 - 6:30 (The Tail): A long, sustained afterglow with zero mental exhaustion or "Grey Layer" onset.
II. TECHNICAL OBSERVATIONS
The Purge: A single physical nausea event occurred mid-peak. Post-purge, the signal clarity increased significantly, transitioning into a focused observer state.
Calibration: Identified 1.1g as the current "Beautiful Sweet Spot." It was manageable and provided high visual complexity without the "Malicious Weight" or physical drag of heavier strains like Makilla Gorilla.
Motor Pathway Reading: Despite high visual entropy, the subject maintained the ability to "search" for motor pings across the C4 disconnect.
III. PROJECTION NOTES: THE 1.5g EXPERIMENT
Target: Increasing from 1.1g to 1.5g for the next calibration.
Rationale: While 1.1g was a success, the additional 0.4g is intended to push the signal from "Observation" to "Active Ignition."
Anticipated Shift: Based on visual processing research, moving to 1.5g of high-potency Blue Vuittons (approaching a 26mg+ psilocybin payload) will likely shift visuals from "swirling" to "geometric dissolution" and increase cortical noise.
IV. CONCLUSION
The 1.1g Blue Vuitton mission is the new gold standard for baseline research. It confirms that this weight provides a high-resolution window into the motor pathways while maintaining full cognitive control.
